page.overview:
Who is Kursk?

Magmaniac Furnace Battle Beast Machine Head

Kursk is a minor antagonist in Invincible, debuting from Season 1 and onwards.

He is a Russian supervillain that can control electricity and was the enemy of Red Rush. After Red Rush died during his battle with Omni-Man along with the other original members of the Guardians of the Globe, he would later work as a bodyguard for Machine Head.

Kursk wears a yellow suit that covers his entire body. His eyes are covered by orange lightning bolts that point outwards, in opposite directions. On his elbows and the upper part of his calves are yellow lightning bolts that are the same color as his suit. Finally, he has a yellow crest on the top of his head, shaped similarly to a lightning bolt as well.
